description: Audit one page's static HTML for accessibility problems and name the WCAG 2.2 criterion for each: missing lang or title, images without alt, unlabeled form fields, vague or empty links and buttons, heading jumps, no main landmark, zoom-blocking viewport, autoplay with sound, tabindex above zero, duplicate ids, click handlers on non-interactive elements, tiny inline targets. It reads markup only and cannot test contrast, focus order or script-built widgets.

compareUrl.description: A second URL (for example the redesign): returns what was fixed, what is new and what remains

name: audit_page_accessibility
title: Page accessibility
